query_referencia: SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_gasto AS DECIMAL)) AS total FROM frota_gastoFrota WHERE ano_referencia = 2025;
query_gerada: SELECT SUM(CAST(g.vlr_gasto AS DECIMAL)) AS total_gasto_frota FROM frota_gastoFrota g JOIN frota_frota f ON g.seq_veiculo = f.seq_veiculo WHERE g.ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(f.dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%' AND COALESCE(f.dsc_num_placa, '') NOT IN ('-1', 'NÃO INFORMADO');
